ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The macro-level ratio is approximately 1:3, with high-intensity (white) pixels occupying roughly 25-30% of the fluke surface against a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-intensity mottling is concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. The right lobe features a fragmented, high-contrast white region extending from the mid-section to the trailing edge. The left lobe features a distinct, contiguous white block at the lateral tip and sparse, narrow linear white filaments closer to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch forms an acute V-shape with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular serrations and deep indentations. The left lobe trailing edge displays moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations, presenting a relatively more continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer edges of both lobes follow a concave curve, sweeping outwards and upwards to narrow, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters are visible on the distal half of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity linear streaks (scratches) are visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented diagonally from the trailing edge towards the interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular deformation and jagged tissue loss are visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe exhibits a distinctly more 'sawtooth' edge profile compared to the relatively smoother topography of the left lobe.
